Answer: C
Reason: The CT images (Figures 4a and 4b) clearly show hyperdense, branching material within the pulmonary arteries consistent with acrylic cement emboli, a known complication of vertebroplasty or kyphoplasty. This vascular obstruction explains the post-operative findings of pronounced vessels in the upper and ventral lung areas due to redirected blood flow or local vascular reaction.
